description: We are a Team of computer science students working on the space mission design challenge to create interactive space science tools.
summary:
**BAGS EXPLORE** is an educational lunar exploration game developed using Unity, designed to make space exploration and mission planning interactive and engaging. Based on the LUNAR ICE RELAY mission concept, the project allows players to experience the challenges of planning and executing a lunar exploration mission.

Players can explore the lunar surface using rovers, complete scientific objectives, collect samples and select mission equipment. The simulation introduces real-world space mission planning concepts, including budget management, payload mass, power consumption and resource allocation.

BAGS EXPLORE also educates players about the lunar south pole, permanently shadowed regions, water ice, scientific instruments and CubeSat relay communications.

The project addresses the challenge of making complex space exploration concepts easier to understand through interactive gameplay. By combining education, simulation and strategic decision-making, BAGS EXPLORE provides an engaging way to discover the science and challenges behind future lunar exploration missions.
details:
Project Details – BAGS EXPLORE

BAGS EXPLORE is an interactive 3D lunar exploration game based on the LUNAR ICE RELAY mission concept. Developed using Unity and C#, the project combines space exploration, scientific discovery and strategic mission planning to create an engaging educational experience.

Players take part in a simulated lunar mission, exploring the lunar south pole using a 3D rover. They investigate potential water-ice locations, collect scientific samples and complete mission objectives. The experience also introduces important space technologies, including CubeSat relay communications, scientific instruments and lunar exploration equipment.

A key feature of the project is its mission-planning system, which introduces real-world challenges such as budget allocation, payload mass, power consumption and resource management. Players must consider these factors when preparing their missions.

BAGS EXPLORE aims to make complex space science more accessible through interactive gameplay. Its creative approach combines realistic space mission concepts with simulation and educational gaming, encouraging curiosity about lunar exploration and humanity's future in space.

The project was designed with educational value, scientific accuracy, usability and an engaging player experience in mind.
